score_rules.DF_motion_event: mean of available ISR, LRA and EndState rates; LRA_strict remains diagnostic. This aggregation is local.
score_rules.RF_fullframe: Binary Attribute QA across all series, extracted only from target_prompt.txt: mean over predefined facts (yes=1; no/unknown/invalid=0). Each fact has one primary Color/Material/Texture/Environment/Lighting category. Category scores are diagnostic slices; categories absent from the target prompt receive no invented questions and remain N/A, not zero. Overall RF is not a mean of category means.
score_rules.AP: mean of temporal property answers; yes requires the target property to be both correct and consistent on the same target across the eight sampled frames; no/unknown/invalid=0
score_rules.camera: keep original Rot/Trans/CamMC errors; do not mix raw errors into DF_motion_event
